caption: Arms full of groceries, and the man in
alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses at a grocery store door, arms full of bags with a wine bottle and a dripping egg carton, glaring at a man walking off on his phone. Text at the top reads: If you can't hold a door for the person three steps behind you, I don't care how many motivational quotes you post. A red box at the bottom reads: Manners are free. I checked.
